scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --compatibility-date=2026-05-12 --kv=PRODUCTS_KV --binding ADMIN_PASSWORD=$ADMIN_PASSWORD --binding SESSION_SECRET=$SESSION_SECRET
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name kissui-site --branch main
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.worker.toml
